ops.old: Dark chocolate egg shells filled with salted caramel ganache, joined and brushed with edible gold lustre until they shine like golden eggs. Melt 300g dark chocolate gently and brush into 16 half-egg moulds in two coats, chilling between, then set. Heat 80ml cream and pour over 100g chopped milk chocolate, then stir in 3 tbsp thick caramel and a pinch of sea salt and cool until thick. Fill the shells, warm the rims on a hot tray and press halves together. Chill, unmould and brush with edible gold lustre.
